proposed_adaptation.scheduler: native historical hybrid pass loop, never C-prime evaluator scheduling
proposed_adaptation.input: retained mapped bytes; explicit new reconstructed input identity where canonical input absent
proposed_adaptation.candidate_semantics: refresh critical-instance order at pass start; enumerate all candidates from current per-instance base; evaluate-all/select-best; commit once per instance; continue to next instance on updated text
proposed_adaptation.parallelism: candidate workers only; preserve submission order and strict/tie acceptance
proposed_adaptation.random: one seeded RNG per run; shuffle candidate list inside each instance only
proposed_adaptation.JOINT: mixed stage preserved after singles; retain sorted accepted-instance pair order and declared pair limit; no silent symmetry to controls
proposed_adaptation.safety: reuse current metadata/multioutput/tristate-aware models and F1/F2/duplicate/connection gates on complete candidate within correct top; gate before STA and before commit
proposed_adaptation.counting: append-only proposal/evaluation/precheck/STA reservation/actual launch/result/cache/commit events, distinct baseline/refresh/final STA; no new cache or duplicate skips in first same-scheduler reconstruction
proposed_adaptation.transactions: unique run/pass/instance/trial directories with base/candidate/raw SHA; no overwriting; exact evaluated artifact committed
proposed_adaptation.acceptance: preserve _accepts strict WNS and optional exact-WNS-tie TNS; no epsilon change
proposed_adaptation.proof: reuse common final_sec and evidence receipt for full retained initial vs committed final; unsupported/timeout/nonzero noncomplete; input/model/source/certificate hashes checked before and after
proposed_adaptation.validation: mock traces must distinguish evaluate-all/select-best from first-improvement and demonstrate >1 commit/pass, submission-order ties, seeded shuffle, no-improvement termination, budget behavior and JOINT reapplication legality
